Name: Total Target
Expression:
VAR TargetContext =
    DISTINCT(
        SELECTCOLUMNS(
            SUMMARIZE(
                'Fact_Sales',
                'Date_Table'[Date],
                'Fact_Sales'[Region],
                'Dim_Product'[Category]
            ),
            "YearMonth", FORMAT([Date], "yyyy-MM"),
            "Region", [Region],
            "Category", [Category]
        )
    )
RETURN
CALCULATE(
    SUM('Monthly_Sales_Targets'[Target_Sales]),
    TREATAS(
        TargetContext,
        'Monthly_Sales_Targets'[YearMonth],
        'Monthly_Sales_Targets'[Region],
        'Monthly_Sales_Targets'[Category]
    )
)

Name: Product Rank
Expression:
VAR CurrentSales = [Total Sales]
RETURN
IF(
    HASONEVALUE('Dim_Product'[Product_Name]),
    RANKX(
        ALL('Dim_Product'),
        [Total Sales],
        CurrentSales,
        DESC,
        Dense
    ),
    BLANK()
)
